headline: UK adds £120M for AI testing and launches an AI biosecurity lab
body: Britain's Treasury set out a pre-Budget AI package of over £600 million, including £120 million more for the AI Security Institute and a £100 million AI Biosecurity Lab backed by up to £200 million in OpenAI and Anthropic credits. It lifted Alignment & Control (+0.6) and cut Catastrophic Risk (-0.3). Texas became the ninth state to sue OpenAI, asking for a court-appointed evaluator to approve new models (Tech Backlash +0.04). China's Nanbeige released an open-weight 33B agent model (Power Concentration -0.13). The dark endings fell most: Self-Destruction and Conquerors both dropped, while Libertarian Utopia and Egalitarian Utopia rose. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -14.88 from -15.68.
movers_note: Self-Destruction -0.6, mostly from the UK AI security package (-0.57) and the Texas suit (-0.01). Libertarian Utopia +0.5, from the UK package (+0.45) and Nanbeige's open model (+0.08). Conquerors -0.5, mostly from the UK package (-0.51).
coming_up: UK Budget on Wednesday 28 October formally confirms the AI package
